forensic_audit_phase: Phase 5 - Independent Database Forensics & Comparative Audit

2_schema_identical_databases.details: All 15 table schemas and all indexes are 100% identical.

differences.explanation: Byte offset 16164 (0x17 vs 0x09) and 16193 (0x9C vs 0x8E) represent internal cell pointer delta on page 3 corresponding exactly to the autoincrement updates in sqlite_sequence for bot_performance_memory (+14) and strategy_bot_allocations (+14).

4_metadata_only_differences.details: Differences are strictly confined to sqlite_sequence autoincrement counters (+14 bot allocations, +14 performance records) and corresponding cell offsets on page 3.

5_unresolved_differences.details: Zero unexplained data modifications, zero trade mutations, zero schema changes.

database_write_source_investigation.safety_recommendation: Preserve existing production DB without automatic restoration or mutation; test suites must continue using isolated temp databases via tests/conftest.py.
